quest.title: With Lupical...
quest.description: According to the witch's dictionary, this assignment takes place in Wolvendom. Go there and see what awaits you this time...
quest.rewards_formatted: Hero's Wit x3, Guide to Resistance x3, Mora x30000

chapter.title: Witch's Homework: Of the Little Wolf Pack

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Razor!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: *sniff* Familiar scent. Ah, you two.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: You have been good?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, yep! We're doing great! Oh, but what happened to Boreas, Razor? We saw you talking just now. Is it a secret?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: We go on hunt. I try to convince... wolf lord.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A hunt?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Oh, {NICKNAME}, is that Razor's "task"?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are the wolves out of food? Is that why you're going on a hunt?

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: No. This hunt is not for food.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: We hunt... enemies. The dark wolf pack. Strange scent coming from land they took. Getting stronger...

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: We must hunt enemies to purify the forest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so did Boreas agree? Paimon remembers last time he said something like...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Razor, you must not get involved. This is for the wolves to settle between themselves."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, sorry, Razor. Paimon didn't mean to dig that up again...

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: It's okay. I know Lupical means no harm. Besides, teacher taught me how to talk to wolf lord.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lisa taught you how to talk to him...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Like, she told you what to say? So that means you got him to agree then, right?

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Yes. Words were... hard. But I did it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah, so you actually managed to convince that giant, stubborn old fella! That's super impressive, Razor!

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Dark wolves are enemies of the whole world. Teacher said this is not wolf problem. This is world problem... And wolf lord agreed.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: But, because of that, other wolves won't join. This war is between me and dark wolf pack...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, count us in too! Those awful Rifthounds have been getting on our nerves for a while!

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Th—Thank you... Help makes for easy hunt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of, how is this hunt gonna work?

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: We set trap. Chase dark wolves here. Into trap.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Then wolf lord pin them down, and we... finish hunt.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Tell me when ready. We start hunt.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's do this!

choices.text: The forest boars have grown big enough.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was close! Good thing the wolves were there to help!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They intercepted those Rifthounds for us, and even drove them away!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: But this isn't... wolf problem...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're doing this to help your Lupical, right? Well, they want you to be safe too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon bets they went to the Wolf King and said, "Listen here! This isn't just our Lupical's problem. This is the world's problem!"... And then rushed over to help!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Hm, "Lupical" is... "Lupical."

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: I am human, but I do not need to be wolf to be "Lupical." I... just want to help them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well said, Razor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe Lupus Boreas agreed to let the pack help...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because he knows your heart.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: You... think so?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, absolutely! Now, c'mon! Let's go kick some Rifthound butt!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We did it!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Thank you... for helping. I thought protecting Lupical was up to me.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: But, Lupical also...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here because we care about you, just like you do us! That's what makes us Lupical, right?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Right... We are Lupical forever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww.. and now, there won't be any more intruders in Wolvendom!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: No... Dark wolf pack, rip open sky. They... could come again.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: But, me and Lupical will hunt them down... no matter what.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Don't forget about us, now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, if you ever need help, just say the word! We're here for you!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: I... appreciate it.

dialogues.speaker: Distant Howl
dialogues.text: Awoo!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: They... call for me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like they wanna make sure you're safe.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Then... I should go. Thank you... for the help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't mention it! That's what Lupical is for!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With Wolvendom safe for now, Razor bids you farewell and head into the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Amid the dense foliage, you notice several pairs of eyes regarding him with warmth, waiting to welcome him home.
